channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2022-26501 — Veeam Backup & Replication
item.description: Threat Signal 71. The Veeam Distribution Service in the Backup & Replication application allows unauthenticated users to access internal API functions. A remote attacker can send input to the internal API which may lead to uploading and executing of malicious code.

item.title: CVE-2018-19323 — GIGABYTE Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 72. The GPCIDrv and GDrv low-level drivers in GIGABYTE App Center, AORUS Graphics Engine, XTREME Gaming Engine, and OC GURU expose functionality to read and write arbitrary physical memory. This could be leveraged by a local attacker to elevate privileges.

item.title: CVE-2013-3163 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code or cause a denial of service via a crafted website.

item.title: CVE-2022-27518 — Citrix Application Delivery Controller (ADC) and Gateway
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Citrix Application Delivery Controller (ADC) and Gateway, when configured with SAML SP or IdP configuration, contain an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows an attacker to execute code as administrator.

item.title: CVE-2023-29492 — Novi Survey Novi Survey
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Novi Survey contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code on the server in the context of the service account.

item.title: CVE-2022-42948 — Fortra Cobalt Strike
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Fortra Cobalt Strike User Interface contains an unspecified vulnerability rooted in Java Swing that may allow remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2018-5430 — TIBCO JasperReports
item.description: Threat Signal 68. TIBCO JasperReports Server contain a vulnerability which may allow any authenticated user read-only access to the contents of the web application, including key configuration files.

item.title: CVE-2022-26500 — Veeam Backup & Replication
item.description: Threat Signal 69. The Veeam Distribution Service in the Backup & Replication application allows unauthenticated users to access internal API functions. A remote attacker can send input to the internal API which may lead to uploading and executing of malicious code.

item.title: CVE-2021-27878 — Veritas Backup Exec Agent
item.description: Threat Signal 73. Veritas Backup Exec (BE) Agent contains a command execution vulnerability that could allow an attacker to use a data management protocol command to execute a command on the BE Agent machine.

item.title: CVE-2022-4135 — Google Chromium GPU
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Google Chromium GPU contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability that allows a remote attacker, who has compromised the renderer process, to potentially perform a sandbox escape via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2013-2094 — Linux Kernel
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Linux kernel fails to check all 64 bits of attr.config passed by user space, resulting to out-of-bounds access of the perf_swevent_enabled array in sw_perf_event_destroy(). Explotation allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2023-2033 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2023-21674 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Microsoft Windows Advanced Local Procedure Call (ALPC) contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2022-3075 — Google Chromium Mojo
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Google Chromium Mojo contains an insufficient data validation vulnerability that allows a remote attacker, who has compromised the renderer process, to potentially perform a sandbox escape via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2013-6282 — Linux Kernel
item.description: Threat Signal 66. The get_user and put_user API functions of the Linux kernel fail to validate the target address when being used on ARM v6k/v7 platforms. This allows an application to read and write kernel memory which could lead to privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2023-22952 — SugarCRM Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Multiple SugarCRM products contain a remote code execution vulnerability in the EmailTemplates. Using a specially crafted request, custom PHP code can be injected through the EmailTemplates.

item.title: CVE-2023-2136 — Google Chromium Skia
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Google Chromium Skia contains an integer overflow vulnerability that allows a remote attacker, who has compromised the renderer process, to potentially perform a sandbox escape via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability affects Google Chrome and ChromeOS, Android, Flutter, and possibly other products.

item.title: CVE-2021-27876 — Veritas Backup Exec Agent
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Veritas Backup Exec (BE) Agent contains a file access vulnerability that could allow an attacker to specially craft input parameters on a data management protocol command to access files on the BE Agent machine.

item.title: CVE-2022-41073 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Microsoft Windows Print Spooler contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an attacker to gain SYSTEM-level privileges.

item.title: CVE-2018-19322 — GIGABYTE Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 66. The GPCIDrv and GDrv low-level drivers in GIGABYTE App Center, AORUS Graphics Engine, XTREME Gaming Engine, and OC GURU II expose functionality to read/write data from/to IO ports. This could be leveraged in a number of ways to ultimately run code with elevated privileges.

item.title: CVE-2021-3493 — Linux Kernel
item.description: Threat Signal 66. The overlayfs stacking file system in Linux kernel does not properly validate the application of file capabilities against user namespaces, which could lead to privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2023-23376 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) driver contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2015-2291 — Intel Ethernet Diagnostics Driver for Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Intel ethernet diagnostics driver for Windows IQVW32.sys and IQVW64.sys contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for a denial-of-service (DoS).

Google Chromium Network Service contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2022-41128 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Microsoft Windows contains an unspecified vulnerability in the JScript9 scripting language which allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2019-1388 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Microsoft Windows Certificate Dialog contains a privilege escalation vulnerability, allowing attackers to run processes in an elevated context.

item.title: CVE-2020-3433 — Cisco AnyConnect Secure
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Cisco AnyConnect Secure Mobility Client for Windows interprocess communication (IPC) channel allows for insufficient validation of resources that are loaded by the application at run time. An attacker with valid credentials on Windows could execute code on the affected machine with SYSTEM privileges.

item.title: CVE-2023-28205 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and Safari WebKit contain a use-after-free vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2018-19320 — GIGABYTE Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 67. The GDrv low-level driver in GIGABYTE App Center, AORUS Graphics Engine, XTREME Gaming Engine, and OC GURU II exposes ring0 memcpy-like functionality that could allow a local attacker to take complete control of the affected system.

item.title: CVE-2022-38181 — Arm Mali Graphics Processing Unit (GPU)
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Arm Mali GPU Kernel Driver contains a use-after-free vulnerability that may allow a non-privileged user to gain root privilege and/or disclose information.

item.title: CVE-2017-6742 — Cisco IOS and IOS XE Software
item.description: Threat Signal 62. The Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) subsystem of Cisco IOS and IOS XE contains a vulnerability that could allow an authenticated, remote attacker to remotely execute code on an affected system or cause an affected system to reload.

item.title: CVE-2023-2868 — Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) Appliance
item.description: Threat Signal 78. Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG) appliance contains an improper input validation vulnerability of a user-supplied .tar file, leading to remote command injection.

item.title: CVE-2016-3427 — Oracle Java SE and JRockit
item.description: Threat Signal 78. Oracle Java SE and JRockit contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote attackers to affect confidentiality, integrity, and availability via vectors related to Java Management Extensions (JMX). This vulnerability can be exploited through sandboxed Java Web Start applications and sandboxed Java applets. It can also be exploited by supplying data to APIs in the specified component without using sandboxed Java Web Start applications or sandboxed Java applets, such as through a web service.

item.title: CVE-2016-8735 — Apache Tomcat
item.description: Threat Signal 78. Apache Tomcat contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution if JmxRemoteLifecycleListener is used and an attacker can reach Java Management Extension (JMX) ports. This CVE exists because this listener wasn't updated for consistency with the Oracle patched issues for CVE-2016-3427 which affected credential types.

item.title: CVE-2022-26258 — D-Link DIR-820L
item.description: Threat Signal 78. D-Link DIR-820L contains an unspecified vulnerability in Device Name parameter in /lan.asp which allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-35587 — Oracle Fusion Middleware

item.title: CVE-2022-41352 — Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS)

item.title: CVE-2023-23397 — Microsoft Office

item.title: CVE-2022-28810 — Zoho ManageEngine

item.title: CVE-2022-41223 — Mitel MiVoice Connect
